Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Ceiling Pendant Light Chandelier Fixture With Glass Shade - 11.5 x 11.5 x 42 Inches, Black
Colors: Black
Materials: Metal
This smartly designed modern pendant light will add a sophisticated twist to a modern kitchen, dining room or bar area. Black metal is paired with a glass shade. Modern, clean style Metal hardware with charcoal finish, clear glass shade Provides ample light along with a strong, modern style statement 42"H x 11.5"W x 11.5"D Product is hardwired (professional installation recommended) Intended for indoor use only
